newsitem.title: DUBAI: Omani stocks extend strong gains.
newsitem.headline: Omani stocks extend strong gains.

text.p: Oman's stocks extended skyrocketing gains in the week to Wednesday with heavy demand on banking and investment stocks, a market report said.
The Muscat Securities Market said the index rose to 277.19 points from last week's 252.53 points.
The value of the week's total trade rose to 30.2 million rials ($80 million) from 19.6 million rials the previous close.
Some 10.5 million shares changed hands in 3,832 deals compared with last week's 6.6 million shares in 2,925 deals.
Of the 64 companies traded, 49 rose, seven were steady and eight fell.
Oman International Bank was among this week's major gainers, jumping 1.300 rials to close at 4.800 rials.
Bank Muscat al-Ahli al-Omani followed, closing at 5.600 rials from 4.500 rials last week.
The banking and investment sectors accounted for 71 percent of the week's total trade value.
